node.statement: Coefficient extraction: ||a||=|h|||u||, abs(||u||-1)<=C0*e, and ||u||>=1/2. The preceding square estimate first gives |h|<=2[1+(C0+1)e]||X||^2, and then abs(|h|-||X||^2)<=abs(|h|-|h|||u||)+abs(||a||-||X||^2)<=C1*e*||X||^2 for a universal finite C1 after e<=min{t0,1}.
